 afk Dashboard 
╭─ Sessions ────────────────────────────────╮╭─ feat-auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│     NAME                PHASE     TASKS   ││   Overview   Waves   Stack   Notes   Diff               tab/1-5: switch │
│         ╭─ actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮──────── │
│ ▌ ● feat│ type to filter, or press an action's key                                                         │         │
│   ● Bill│                                                                                                  │ng       │
│   ● fix-│ n  new session                         — Start a new session from a plan or a branch             │         │
│   ○ feat│ o  one-off session                     — Start a one-off session with no plan                    │         │
│   ● scra│ p  switch project                      — Switch to another project                               │         │
│   ○ old-│ A  all projects                        — this dashboard was started without the project reader   │         │
│         │ +  add a project                       — adding a project is not available here                  │         │
│         │ -  remove the project                  — removing a project is not available here                │         │
│         │ c  clean session                       — Clean the selected session and its worktree             │         │
│         │ r  restart agent                       — only a stopped or stuck agent can be restarted          │         │
│         │ l  edit label                          — Give the selected session a display label               │         │
│         │ /  filter sessions                     — Filter the session list by name                         │         │
│         │ x  clear filter                        — no filter is applied                                    │         │
│         │ b  build tasks                         — this project has no build                               │         │
│         │ i  inbox                               — the inbox has not been read yet                         │         │
│         │ P  pause the build                     — this project has no build                               │         │
│         │ U  resume the build                    — this project has no build                               │         │
│         │ S  set this task's status              — this dashboard cannot change the ledger                 │         │
│         │ f  focus the right side                — Move the keyboard to the right side                     │         │
│         │ t  agent or overview                   — focus the right side first (enter)                      │         │
│         │ \  back to list                        — the session list already has the keyboard               │         │
│         │ \  close pane                          — no agent pane is open                                   │         │
│         │ g  mouse                               — Let the terminal select text, or take the mouse back    │         │
│         │ w  resize panes                        — Move the divider between the list and the right side    │         │
│         │ ?  help                                — Show every key on the session list, or hide them again  │         │
│         │ q  quit                                — Leave the dashboard; every session keeps running        │         │
│         │    extend the plan                     — Start a planning session that adds work to the plan     │         │
│         │    amend the plan                      — Change the plan; asks what to change in a sentence      │         │
│         │    reconcile the plan with a document  — Fit the plan to a document; asks for its path           │         │
│         │    start a new plan                    — starting a plan is not available here                   │         │
│         │    check the plan                      — checking the plan is not available here                 │         │
│         │    approve the plan                    — approving is not available here                         │         │
│         ╰──────────────────────────────────────────── key runs · enter runs · type to filter · esc closes ─╯         │
│                                           ││                                                                         │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────╯╰───────── enter: focus view · ctrl+space c: clean · ctrl+space l: label ─╯
enter run · ↑/↓ move · type filter · esc close · ctrl+space close, or pass it to the agent
